provenance.sanitization: Sanitized of internal PII, real corporate hostnames, and credentials. IPs mapped to RFC 5737 documentation prefixes.

metadata.description: Defensive evaluation telemetry sourced independently from public detection engineering datasets to evaluate detection precision, recall, and false-positive immunity.

scenarios.description: MSBuild LOLBin compiling and executing untrusted XML project payload in memory.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Removed victim corporate network paths and internal user IDs; replaced payload destination with C:\\Users\\Public\\payload.xml; mapped operator domain to ENTERPRISE\\operator.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Extracted Sysmon Event 1 schema fields (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User) into canonical JSON event payload.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Invoking MSBuild.exe to compile and execute unverified XML/C# code bypasses standard application control policies and code signing requirements.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1127.001 (Trusted Developer Utilities Proxy Execution: MSBuild): Adversaries use MSBuild to execute malicious code via trusted Windows build utilities.

scenarios.description: Repeated anomalous Windows logon failures indicating automated credential stuffing.

raw_event.Message: An account failed to log on. Status 0xC000006D

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Replaced real attacker IP with RFC 5737 documentation address 198.51.100.180; replaced victim hostname with EXTERNAL-DESKTOP.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Formatted Event 4625 EventData elements including TargetUserName, Status, WorkstationName, IpAddress into structured event object.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Automated failed authentication attempts targeting privileged accounts like administrator indicate active brute force credential access.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1110.001 (Brute Force: Password Guessing): Repeated failed logons with Status 0xC000006D from external IPs represent systematic password guessing.

scenarios.description: Scheduled task registered to launch staging payload at elevated startup.

provenance.original_event_format: Windows Security Event ID 4698 (Scheduled Task Created)
provenance.sanitization_procedure: Sanitized internal task path to \\Microsoft\\Windows\\MaintenanceUpdater and payload path to C:\\Users\\Public\\updater.ps1.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Mapped TaskName, TaskContent (XML actions), and SubjectUserName from Event 4698 telemetry schema.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Creating scheduled tasks that run bypass PowerShell scripts out of Public directories is a standard persistence technique.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1053.005 (Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task): Adversaries use task scheduler to maintain persistent elevated access across reboots.

scenarios.description: Regsvr32 executing remote COM scriptlet payload (Squiblydoo attack pattern).

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Replaced staging server IP with RFC 5737 address 198.51.100.45; sanitized domain and operator identity.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Captured Sysmon 1 command line arguments (/s /n /u /i:...) and parent process context.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Regsvr32 invoked with /i pointing to a remote scriptlet URL is the classic Squiblydoo application whitelist bypass.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1218.010 (System Binary Proxy Execution: Regsvr32): Using regsvr32 to proxy execution of untrusted COM scriptlets.

scenarios.description: Wmic executing shadowcopy deletion to prevent system recovery during ransomware staging.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Sanitized system user context and hostname.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Normalized process image C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\wmic.exe and CommandLine wmic shadowcopy delete.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Deleting volume shadow copies is typical pre-encryption behavior by ransomware operators to inhibit victim recovery.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1490 (Inhibit System Recovery): Adversaries delete or remove system volume shadow copies to prevent rollback after compromise.

scenarios.description: PowerShell command disabling Windows Defender Real-time Protection and adding exclusion path.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Targeted exclusion folder sanitized to C:\\Temp.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Mapped 4688 NewProcessName, CommandLine, and TargetUserName parameters.
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Disabling real-time monitoring and adding AV exclusions weakens host defense controls ahead of payload drops.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1562.001 (Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools): Adversaries modify security tools and configurations to evade detection.

scenarios.description: Untrusted binary initiating outbound TCP connection to remote C2 infrastructure on port 4444.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Destination IP mapped to RFC 5737 198.51.100.99; binary masquerading in C:\\Users\\Public.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Structured Sysmon Event 3 schema fields (Image, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Protocol, User).
provenance.label_justification: Malicious: Unsigned binary in a Public folder masquerading as svchost connecting out to high-risk port 4444 indicates backdoor C2.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: T1071 (Application Layer Protocol): Adversaries communicate using application layer protocols over non-standard ports to bypass boundary inspection.

scenarios.description: Developer running standard automated pytest test suite in local virtualenv.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Sanitized developer workstation hostname and local username to ENTERPRISE\\developer.
provenance.transformation_procedure: Directly captured legitimate developer invocation of python.exe -m pytest from PowerShell.
provenance.label_justification: Benign: Standard software quality test runner invocation in developer virtualenv.
provenance.mitre_mapping_justification: None (Benign Operational Activity): Not associated with adversarial tactics.

scenarios.description: Standard git version control fetch and status operation.

provenance.transformation_procedure: Captured Sysmon 1 process creation of standard git version control binary.
provenance.label_justification: Benign: Routine source code version control fetch operation from legitimate Program Files location.

scenarios.description: Authorized employee interactive workstation logon at standard start-of-day.

provenance.sanitization_procedure: Target user set to jdoe, workstation FINANCE-PC04, IP 127.0.0.1.
provenance.label_justification: Benign: Legitimate console interactive logon by standard enterprise employee.

scenarios.description: Windows Update Orchestrator scheduled background scan check.

provenance.transformation_procedure: Captured Event 4688 execution of legitimate usoclient.exe from System32.
provenance.label_justification: Benign: Authorized operating system maintenance service checking for security updates.

scenarios.description: Visual Studio Code launching internal TypeScript language server.

provenance.transformation_procedure: Captured VS Code utility process launch for language server.
provenance.label_justification: Benign: Standard developer IDE launching background language parsing service.
